    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_perpendicular_module_equivalence (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P Q : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (hb : Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) (hQ : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose X) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose X)) (gen : ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose X) → IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) X) :
    ∃ (I : Ideal (CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) (x : I.IsTwoSided), (∀ (f : CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential)), f ∈ I ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ ⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) (b : (⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a b = f) ∧ Nonempty (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable ≌ FGModuleCat (CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) ⧸ I)ᵐᵒᵖ)

    The semistable perpendicular category is equivalent to the category of finite right modules over the Bongartz endomorphism ring modulo the ideal of maps factoring through the original cokernel.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.perpendicular_equivalence_of_bongartz (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P T : TwoTerm R) (hp : P.IsPresilting) (ht : T.IsPresilting) (bongartz : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential) M ↔ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)) :
    ∃ (I : Ideal (CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential))) (x : I.IsTwoSided), (∀ (f : CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential)), f ∈ I ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential ⟶ ⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) (b : (⨁ fun (x : Fin n) => CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a b = f) ∧ Nonempty ((CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory fun (M : FGModuleCat R) => Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ M) ∧ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)) ≌ FGModuleCat (CategoryTheory.End (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel T.differential) ⧸ I)ᵐᵒᵖ)

    For the Bongartz completion characterized by its torsion class, the Hom-perpendicular category has the module category of the reduction algebra as its exact model.
